Row Level Security (RLS) adalah fitur pe:
Row Level Security (RLS) is a row-level data restriction feature. With RLS, the Admin can restrict the rows of data that can be analyzed by the AI for specific users.

Use case examples:
• User Jakarta Branch → can only see data where branch_code = 'JKT'
• User Salesman A → can only see data where salesman_id = 12
• User Finance Division → can only see data where division = 'finance'

Without RLS, users can view all contents of the tables permitted by their role.
